title: Notification relay settings (full pipeline)
why: The third pipeline brief, so the pair cannot be answered by a table prior OR a tiles prior: here the right answer is the SETTINGS archetype — grouped sections of explained rows, revisited rarely and changed deliberately — and the tempting wrong answer is a WIZARD: the brief smells like setup (host, token, test connection), but settings are scanned and changed one knob at a time in any order, while a wizard walks once and adds clicks forever after (Fiori's own warning). The secret adds the second discipline: a saved token is write-only, replace-not-read.

forbidden.message: a wizard for configuration — settings are revisited and scanned, one knob at a time in any order; a wizard walks once and adds clicks forever after (settings archetype vs wizard useWhen)
same as WizardTemplate: sequential steps impose an order the operator does not have

acceptance: The saved token value is never rendered: the secret field starts empty, typing replaces, and a configured mark (not the value) says one exists.
Every knob can change alone, in any order — no step sequence and no gating between sections.
Every row carries a description saying what changing it actually affects.
The connection test result names what failed and how to fix it, in words — never a bare pass/fail.
